content_sections.text: Senior Project Associate: Master’s degree in Natural or Agricultural science or Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognised University or equivalent OR Doctoral Degree in Science/Engineering/Technology/Pharma/MD/MS from a recognised university or equivalent, with 8 years’ experience in Research and Development for Master's/Bachelor's holders OR 4 years’ experience in Research for Doctoral degree holders.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad for hiring project research personnel.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post announced in this notification is Senior Project Associate under a project-based research scheme.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Project Associate position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for this recruitment is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Natural or Agricultural science or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology/Medicine with 8 years experience OR a Doctoral Degree in Science/Engineering/Technology/Pharma/MD/MS with 4 years experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Senior Project Associate post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply for this recruitment through online mode by visiting the official application link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for submitting the application form.
